title: metadata-protocol: registry heal and code-layer carry-forward read an action bare, and a refusal is swallowed silently
body:
domain:server#4 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzi1tLRTEYwYGtbNCyk

Carrier filed from contract review 6781770671 on PR #32361 (card #32244, ③ out-of-scope finding 2, confirmed). Child of the ADR-0150 epic #31527.

`restoreArtifactRegistryView` and `readCodeLayerForCarryForward` (packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-registry-hydration.ts) read the metadata service by bare name, with no package. Once #32361 makes a bare read of a name two packages hold refuse, two things happen:
- The read at protocol-registry-hydration.ts:1421 (PR head `ddcaeda0`) sits inside that function's silent outer catch. After an overlay DELETE on such a name, the registry heal is skipped with no log line.
- On main it registered whichever package's item was written last, which is also wrong.

**Fix:** pass the package the slot belongs to on both reads. Never read bare, and never swallow a package-scoped refusal silently. Pin a DELETE-then-heal on a two-package name.

**Governing text:** ADR-0150 D3 and D5 (no silent pick).

**Re-check:** `git grep -n "restoreArtifactRegistryView\|readCodeLayerForCarryForward" packages/metadata-protocol/src`, then read whether the service read passes a package.

**Serial:** after #32361 (#32244) merges.
